response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), above_average AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.avg_hgb), cohort AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_hgb FROM above_average) SELECT a.ID, a.avg_hgb, a.avg_hgb - o.avg_hgb AS above_overall_average, a.avg_hgb - c.avg_hgb AS above_cohort_average FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN cohort AS c ORDER BY above_cohort_average DESC LIMIT 10
